page.overview:
Who is Charlotte Custard?

Charlotte Custard is the sixth daughter and 16th child of the Charlotte Family and the middle triplet sister of Cracker and Angel. She is also an officer of the Big Mom Pirates.

Despite her age, Custard is a slim, young-looking woman who has fair skin, brown eyes, short violet hair adorned with a flower. She wears a purple-pink bodysuit with matching elbow-length gloves and belt around her waist. She also wears a large, fluffy light pink cape with pink polka dots around her shoulders.

Nothing is known about Custard's personality. However, since she took part in Big Mom's plan to assassinate the Vinsmoke Family and led a squad after the Fire Tank Pirates, she can be considered very loyal to her family and crew.

As an officer of the Big Mom Pirates, Custard has authority over lower-ranking members of her crew, being chosen to lead a squad that pursued the Fire Tank Pirates.
